dedupe_keys.name: bpc power data books and annual reports

description: BPC publishes power data books and annual reports. The 2025 data book covers infrastructure, generation and supply, purchased and imported energy, peak demand, service-area performance, tariffs, fibre networks and financial indicators. The provider is Bhutan Power Corporation. Coverage: Coverage is Bhutan Power Corporation’s systems. The latest data book describes 2025 and includes selected five-year comparisons; older 2023 and 2024 editions are also listed. Access: The official download index and 2025 book’s contents and introductory description were read through the web reader. No tabular payload was downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Utility system boundaries and different yearly indicators require care. This inspection did not reproduce totals or check every table against source measurements. For simulation it supplies utility-level network, demand and performance parameters. Related resources: BPSO operational reports and ERA regulatory reports are separate sources.
